description: This file defines a REST API endpoint class ClientRestEndpoint that handles client-related HTTP requests such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting client information. It uses Spring annotations and interacts with service and mapper components.

classes.name: ClientRestEndpoint
classes.description: A REST controller class handling HTTP requests related to client management, including get, create, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: getClientInfo
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve client details by ID. Validates the ID, converts it, and returns client info or error message.

methods.name: createClientInfo
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new client entry from provided resource data.

methods.name: updateClientInfo
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update existing client details.

methods.name: deleteClientInfo
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a client by ID after validation.

methods.name: safe
methods.description: Sanitizes a string input by escaping backslashes and double quotes.

methods.name: isPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks whether a given string is a placeholder pattern for path variables.
